```{r,echo=FALSE}

while(T){
    part = sample(1:199,1)
    whole = sample(1:199,1)
    perc = part/whole*100
    if(perc%%1==0 && perc<100 && whole != 100 && perc!=50){break}
}

```

Question
========

A store's wholesale cost is \$`r whole` per trinket. To calculate the retail price, the store adds a markup percentage of `r perc`%.

Find the retail price in dollars. (Do NOT include `$` in your answer.)


Solution
========

This scenario represents a percent increase. It is beneficial to find the scale factor.

$$\text{scale factor}~=~1+\frac{`r perc`}{100}~=~`r 1+perc/100`$$

Then, multiply the original cost by the scale factor to find the retail price.

$$`r 1+perc/100`\cdot `r whole` = `r whole*(1+perc/100)`$$

So the retail price is \$`r round(whole*(1+perc/100))`.
